<@&1424461167883194418> Model updates — 2026-08-05

### 🆕 New
- 🧠 **Cohere Command A+** (Cohere), **Inkling Small** (Thinking Machines), **Qwen3.8 Max** and **Qwen3.7 Flash** (Qwen) — multimodal text models with tool calling and reasoning
- 🎨 **Krea 2 Medium** (Krea) and **DreamShaper 8 LCM** (Lykon) — text-to-image
- 🎬 **Grok Imagine Video 1.5** (xAI) and **Pruna p-video** (Pruna) — text/image-to-video
- 🔊 **AssemblyAI Universal-3.5 Pro** (AssemblyAI) — transcription; **Kokoro 82M** (Hexgrad) — TTS

### 🗑️ Removed
- `grok-4-20-reasoning`, `gemini-search-fast`, `gemini-search-large`, `perplexity-high` (text)
- `sana` (image), `veo-1080p`, `wan-pro-1080p`, `p-video-720p`, `p-video-1080p` (video), `universal-3-pro` (audio)

### ⬇️ Price cuts
- 🎨 Image: Qwen Image (~15%)
- 🔢 Embeddings: Text Embedding 3 Small · Text Embedding 3 Large (~25%)

### 🔒 Going paid-only
- Mistral Small 3.2 · Mistral Small 4 · Gemma 4 26B A4B · Gemma 4 31B
- MiMo V2.5 · MiMo V2.5 Pro · Meta Llama 4 Scout · Qwen3.7 Plus
- Qwen3 VL 30B A3B Instruct · Qwen3 VL 235B A22B Thinking · StepFun Step 3.7 Flash · StepFun Step 3.5 Flash

### 🔓 Now free
- Kimi K3

### ✨ Capability updates
- `grok` — reasoning now supported
- `MarcosFRG/gemini-2.5-flash-lite`, `MarcosFRG/gemini-3-flash-preview`, `MarcosFRG/mimo-v2.5` — added image, audio, and video input
- `veo`, `seedance-pro`, `wan-pro` — added 1080p resolution options

Explore at https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs
